desc: Derive and verify the formula: min operations = max(maxDepth, ceil(totalDepth / 2)) where depth(x) = number of floor-divisions by 4 to reach 0
Design helper computing totalDepth and maxDepth over [l, r] via intervals [4^k, 4^(k+1)-1] in O(log r)
Implement the solution: per query ans = max(depth(r), (totalDepth + 1) // 2), accumulate sum
Validate against provided examples ([[1,2],[2,4]] -> 3, [[2,6]] -> 4) and brute-force small cases via BFS/greedy simulation
Finalize code in starter template with typing import, O(log r) per query, handling 1e5 queries and r up to 1e9
